system.description:
The freelance riders of the caravan roads and the mercenary companies: a mounted warrior who fights for coin, not a sworn order.

  • Cavalry Strike: while mounted, you can split your mount's movement before and after your attack. The creature you attack can't make an Attack of Opportunity against you or your mount for that movement. Your mount has Advantage on saves against fear while you ride it.
    • 9th level: when you hit with a melee attack after your mount moved at least 20ft this turn, the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
  • Soldier's Rep: Advantage on Persuasion when negotiating pay or contracts, and a name among mercenary companies and caravan guilds.
